milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a small brown mushroom block drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The mushroom is placed at ~(3, 0, 2) on mycelium and there is no other source of brown_mushroom items in the scene, making this check unambiguous.

Uses inventory_has for flower_pot because mining a potted_oxeye_daisy block drops both a flower_pot and an oxeye_daisy item. Checking for flower_pot is reliable since there is no other source of flower pots in this scene. The potted plant is at ~(-3, 0, -2).

Uses inventory_has because crafting a bowl places it into the player's inventory. The player starts with exactly 3 oak planks (the precise recipe requirement) and a crafting table is available at ~(0, 0, 5). No bowl exists in the starting inventory, so having one confirms successful crafting.
